title: Paposh Campus, Karachi | SMIT Campus Location & Details
text: SMIT Campus: Paposh Campus, located in Karachi, Pakistan. Address: C 14, 6B, Block 5-C Block 5 D Block 5 Nazimabad, Karachi, 74600. Google Maps location: https://www.google.com/maps?q=24.9212401,67.0262533. This is one of Saylani Mass IT Training's (SMIT) training centers where free IT courses are delivered on-site. To check current course availability at this campus or enroll, visit https://www.saylanimit.com/enroll and select Karachi as the city.
